subject: O Level E-Math
title: Bearings on level ground
question:
The diagram shows the points A, B, C and D on the level ground where D is due north of B. CD = 9 m, AB = 14.5 m, AD = 6 m, ∠DBC = 30° and ∠DCB = 85°.
(a) Calculate the length of BD.
(b) Calculate the bearing of A from D.
(c) CT is a vertical pole of height 12 m standing at C. X is a point along BD such that the angle of elevation of T from X is the greatest. Find the angle of elevation of T from X.
